name: Dump
author: Alex J. Grant

provenance.note: No documentation found. A smaller 5-entry Dump.Lib also exists on APD036. Author identified from the Ultimate Amiga AMOS Factory archive listing (Dump Extension v1.0, archived by Lonewolf10); the binary carries no attribution.
provenance.redistribution: Third-party extension, redistribution terms unverified. The AMOS PD Library on CD (Weird Science, 1994), archive.org item cdrom-amospdcd. The disc's own Documents/Copyrights states Weird Science claims no copyright over the material, that parts are shareware with fees due, and that users should make no assumption that anything on it is public domain. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

notes: Low-level disc access (Diskin, Secread, Secwrite, Trackformat) plus a screen dump. Table tier. The disc-sector keywords have no counterpart in a virtual filesystem, so much of this is likely to end up n/a rather than merely unimplemented. Slot from Andrew Burton's AMOS Extensions List (kept at ultimateamiga.com, updated 2007-07-29), compiled from the AMOS-LIST archives 1994-1998, Amiga magazine clippings and coverdisk CDs..
